screened.10.1002/ece3.70255: review of plant phenolics and seed dispersal by animals; "ultraviolet" is UV protection in plants, with no photoreceptor or spectral measurement in a bird

note: WebSearch returned result titles and links only (no snippets), so web results were judged by title. Two web queries per trait group: the scientific name, then the common name. Title-less addresses among the 20 spectral results were not judged: link.springer.com/article/10.1007%252FBF00604167 (in both searches), link.springer.com/doi/10.1007/BF00216611, PMC1395858, PMC1365744, a USDA National Wildlife Research Center record (digitalcommons.unl.edu icwdm_usdanwrc 1170) and a findscholars.unh.edu record. The titled results concerned Drosophila, insects, estrildid finches, parrots and a colour-modelling package. binocular_deg, fov_h_deg, cff_hz, eye_movement and interreceptor_deg wait for the wanted list: Martin 2017 (Frontiers in Neuroscience, third in the Phasianidae family review), a Birmingham record of Martin's review of bird visual fields ("Perdix visual field" results), a 2022 preprint on the oculomotor nuclei of birds and a 2010 Ohio thesis on head-bobbing (both listed by the harvest for "Perdix visual acuity"), and a systematic review of critical fusion frequencies (PMC9803175, first for "gray partridge flicker fusion"). Main already holds Perdix perdix acuity_cpd 10.2 from the Caves et al. compilation (canon-5, oa-1).
